sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive county legal administration inquiries within actual county jurisdiction and office remit.
sources.limitations: June 2026 recommended budget, printed p. 123, identifies Brad Stephens as County Counsel; State Bar professional profile publishes email. Budget page image could not be retrieved due to PDF size; extracted text reviewed. County requires claims and service of process through the Clerk of the Board unless specifically agreed otherwise. County counsel represents the county, not the complainant; address is not an independent complaint intake channel, legal filing or service-of-process route. Confirm role, currency and jurisdiction before use. Deliverability not tested.
